Subject: Contract Tango: timeline & next steps for BlueOak evaluation

Alex — thanks for yesterday's demo and for walking through the evaluation goals with Maya. Per our conversation, I sketched a tight mutual action plan so we can hit BlueOak's pilot start target of Aug 4. Attaching a one-page MAP (BlueOak_MAP_v1.xlsx) + a simple milestone timeline.

High-level MAP (owners & dates):
- Technical evaluation kickoff (shared sandbox access): Redwood infra (Ben) -> target: 2025-07-07
- Legal review & redline (MSA + DPA): BlueOak legal (contracts@blueoak.com) -> target: initial comments by 2025-07-10
- Security questionnaire & SOC2 evidence exchange: BlueOak security (Maya) / Redwood security -> target: 2025-07-14
- Order form draft + pricing alignment: Redwood commercial (Ben) + BlueOak procurement -> target: 2025-07-17
- Signatures (MSA+DPA+Order Form) / PO submitted: target: 2025-07-24
- Pilot provisioning & onboarding: target start 2025-08-04

Dependencies / gating notes:
- MSA must be agreed before we provision Dedicated pilot nodes for BlueOak (data isolation requirement).
- DPA negotiation limited to a handful of clauses: data residency, subprocessor list, and retention windows — we can offer a regional restriction to US-East (if needed) to speed review.
- If procurement requires an invoice before signature, please flag ASAP — we can accommodate a subscription start date hold but it affects billing cycles.

Requested next steps:
1) Can BlueOak legal share an initial MSA redline by 2025-07-10? (contracts@blueoak.com)
2) I'll share a short pack of SOC2 artefacts and a SFTP link for evidence by 2025-07-02.
3) Quick 30m sync to lock dates — propose 2025-07-02 11:00am PT.

Attachments: BlueOak_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP + milestone swimlane).

Thanks — I'll keep this light and actionable.

— Ben

1) Data residency: can Redwood commit contractually to keep all pilot data resident in US-East and prevent export outside the US for the duration of the pilot? We will include a DPA clause and would like explicit contractual language.
2) KMS / key management: we need to confirm if BlueOak can bring its own customer-managed keys (BYOK) for the pilot, or if Redwood must provide dedicated key separation. If Redwood supports BYOK, please provide the integration notes.
3) Timeline: we'll try to return consolidated redlines by 7/10 but if we surface significant KMS or residency requirements that change the technical approach, we may need a short extension. Please flag any non-negotiable items from your side.

We look forward to the SOC2 package and the MAP spreadsheet — these will help our security and procurement teams finish the review quickly.
